FN-NRC5488-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 75
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Donnie Chesteen
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 01/27/2026
Senate Bill 75 as introduced could increase or decrease the obligations of certain state agencies
by an undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in the cost of materials or equipment
purchased through competitive bidding agreements under current law compared to cooperative
purchase agreements under this bill.

FN-NRC5488-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 75
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Senator Donnie Chesteen
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/31/2026
Senate Bill 75 as passed the Senate could increase or decrease the obligations of certain state
agencies, local governments, and local boards of education by an undetermined amount
dependent upon the difference in the cost of materials or equipment purchased through
competitive bidding agre under current law compared to cooperative purchase agreements under
this bill.
This bill could also increase or decrease the obligations of certain local governments and local
boards of education by an undetermined amount by requiring that all goods and services
purchased by these entities, through a purchasing cooperative comply with current state
competitive bidding laws.
